disclosure: de-novo A3/A4 mlocarna consensuses of round-0 false-positive-manifest candidates. This is what the de-novo instrument RESOLVES, not what a curated CM-derived structure shows; reports/p3/architecture_freeze.json measures the latter and disclaims itself for this purpose.

allow_wobble.why: allow_wobble is compared against the ACCEPTOR base (WATSON_CRICK[motif_base]); no constrained position of this motif has an acceptor base in WOBBLE_PAIRS, so the flag cannot change any decision for this acceptor end

stem_i_nt_threshold.why: short_stem_i_or_class_ii returns False for a None extent and only the 'translational' regulatory_mode fires the other arm; this manifest supplies neither field, so ultrashort_relax is False at every threshold. ADR-0006 A4's 'an imperfect value errs safe' argument rests on the relaxation firing, so where it does not fire that safety margin is structurally absent and (b) runs as its strict base predicate.

control_and_consequence.note: n_failing_both_a_and_b is the largest set (b) can hand to mining: every other candidate is already spared by (a) or has no consensus at all. share_b_agrees_with_a_passed is (b)'s sensitivity against D3's own model-independent anchor and changes no outcome.

positive_control.caveat: a single de-novo positive control; it bounds the choice in one direction (a value that fails it mines a known T-box) and supports no rate
